name: self-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own context at task milestones: agent-initiated /compact with self-written instructions, gated by context size, then auto-continue.

floorPct.title: 压缩下限 (%)
floorPct.description: 上下文占窗口低于此百分比时拒绝 compact_now

maxPostRatio.title: 压后/压前比例上限
maxPostRatio.description: 预计压后大小占当前大小的上限，超过则拒绝

nudgeStartPct.title: 开始提醒 (%)
nudgeStartPct.description: 上下文占比达到此值后开始提醒模型留意节点

nudgeStepPct.title: 提醒间隔 (%)
nudgeStepPct.description: 每上涨此百分点再提醒一次

urgentPct.title: 升级提醒 (%)
urgentPct.description: 达到此值后提醒措辞升级为尽快压缩

enabled.title: 启用
enabled.description: 关闭后 compact_now 全部拒绝，且不再提醒
